task: Recheck the previously reported Java/C++ acceptance difference in the Julia Accumulator project.
observation: Direct `check --json` runs on `examples/swarm/Julia/Accumulator/src/main.moss` show Java accepts it while C++ rejects at line 27 with `MOSS_COMPILE_ERROR`, saying no matching `Accumulator.increment_by` method exists. The older status recorded an unknown unqualified Java call; the current Java result changed after object method body checking was added.
impact: This is an unresolved source acceptance difference. The full project has not been minimized, and generated Rust or native behavior was not checked, so the result does not establish which compiler is semantically correct.

resolution.summary: Minimize the call and argument-type context before classifying the C++ rejection or Java acceptance.
